svg.title: XIAO ESP32-C5 / standalone with GPS + microSD
svg.desc: Priority: screen > GPS > microSD > buzzer > LEDs. All five fit on the 11 header GPIOs.
svg.text: XIAO ESP32-C5 / standalone with GPS + microSD
Priority: screen > GPS > microSD > buzzer > LEDs. All five fit on the 11 header GPIOs.
Screen D4/23 + D5/24; GPS RX D7/12; microSD SCK D8/8, MISO D9/9, MOSI D10/10, CS D6/11.
Buzzer D3/7; LEDs D0/1 increasing, D1/0 decreasing, D2/25 steady. Labels show D-number / GPIO.
Use native USB for flash / console. Bus disabled; no RS-485 module or universal identification harness.

g.text: Two bidirectional BSS138 channels. LV = 3.3 V; HV = 5 V; all grounds joined.
Shifter: LV supply to xiao 3V3; HV supply to regulated +5 V; GND to common ground.
Each MOSFET: gate to 3.3 V; source to LV signal; drain to matching HV signal.
LCD VCC to +5 V; GND to common ground. Configured address 0x27; verify address and adjust contrast.
Pull-ups shown are TOTAL per line/side: reuse fitted resistors, do not blindly add parallel sets.

svg.text: 2 GPS / Grove Air530 / receive-only UART0 at 9600 baud
GPS RX: leave disconnected (tx_pin = -1). Use connector signal labels to establish orientation.
100 nF at GPS VCC/GND. Coordinates locate this receiver; a fresh valid fix is required for tagging.
3 microSD / native 3.3 V SPI breakout / SPI2 at 4 MHz
10 kΩ to 3.3 V on CMD and DAT0–DAT3, including unused DAT1 (8) and DAT2 (1); none on CLK.
Account for fitted pull-ups. Contact numbers are for the card, not the adapter header order.
100 nF + 10 µF at VDD/VSS; keep SPI wires short. GPIO11 is CS: do not attach a UART console there.
HW-125 variants need supply/logic verification; this drawing assumes a native 3.3 V breakout.

g.text: BZ1: 5 V passive magnetic buzzer, 20 mA max; D1 band to +5 V.
Q1 lead order: check your part datasheet. No GPIO load drive.
One resistor per LED. Cathode K = flat edge / short lead.

svg.text: Power + antenna / common ground for every fitted block
Separate regulated +5 V -> LCD VCC + shifter HV + buzzer positive; supply GND -> XIAO GND.
100 nF at LCD VCC/GND; 10 µF across local +5 V/GND. Keep independently powered +5 V rails apart.
Allow regulator headroom for board/radio peaks, GPS and card writes; verify stable 3.3 V under load.
Do not feed external power into 3V3_OUT. Use a separate suitable 3.3 V supply if the load exceeds its budget.
Build in priority order / remove optional blocks as needed
Screen: 2 GPIOs; + GPS: 3 total; + microSD: 7; + buzzer: 8; + three LEDs: 11. No free header GPIOs.
All five sections are enabled in this example. Disable absent sections; omit individual LEDs with pin=-1.
One LED shows only its assigned trend. Unknown/stale signal turns LEDs off. Rebuild and flash after edits.
LCD remains a 1602A / PCF8574 at 0x27; small OLED displays need a different driver.
Hardware unverified. Check Q1 pin order, module supply voltages and board silkscreen before powering.
Logical wiring • connectors not drawn to physical pin order • see docs/wiring.md
